quest.title: A Breakthrough in Craft
quest.description: The alchemy shop has opened, but you and Paimon are dizzyingly busy...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a brief trial period, the potion shop opens to great success...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* We just keep getting swarmed with more and more customers. It's been nonstop work for so long, Paimon's starting to feel a bit lightheaded...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We've got a lot of orders. Paimon's not sure we can fill them all on our own.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe we should hire some help...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I was just looking at the sales data, and it seems like you two have quite the talent for business. The potions seem to be flying off the shelves!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Lisa! Perfect timing! We were just talking about how we could use some help around the shop.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh? Are the orders piling up already? Having trouble keeping up?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, we're officially swamped! Paimon never thought we'd get this many customers...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, I can't say I'm surprised by the success. I was actually anticipating this kind of response.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: While you two were busy with the shop, I was talking with Freda about some possible ways to make the business more efficient.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: After observing your work, I made note of several improvements we can make to the brewing, cultivation, and sales aspects of the business.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so you've been doing things behind the scenes this whole time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon kinda thought you were just slacking off...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hey now, I'm actually pretty reliable when it counts!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So how are we supposed to put those improvements in action?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, I discussed things over with Freda, and the two of us came up with a plan.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I'll let her give you the details, though. Why don't you go and find her?

choices.text: We've made quite the name for ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Freda
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Paimon! Hello! Is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we've been a bit swamped lately, so Lisa recommended we find some ways to increase our efficiency...

dialogues.speaker: Freda
dialogues.text: Ah, yes! I discussed that with her as well.

dialogues.speaker: Freda
dialogues.text: Currently, there are three areas you can improve — brewing, cultivation, and sales.

dialogues.speaker: Freda
dialogues.text: Increasing your efficiency in these areas will make it much easier to run your business.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wow, that sounds just like what we need! Let's give it a try, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: Looks like all the preparations needed for this upgrade have been made! Please try it out.

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: You're in luck! I just got a new batch of provisions! Please take a look and see if anything catches your eye!

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: Best of luck with your business!
